query: How will CPF investors benefit from the reduced Total Expense Ratio (TER) caps?
reference_answer: Expenses on investment have a significant impact on returns. Hence, reducing Total Expense Ratio caps will lower the expenses that CPF investors have to bear and increase a fund's per-unit net asset value. This will enable CPF members who have invested in the fund to accumulate their retirement savings faster.The following example illustrates the impact of expense ratio:Amount invested: $10,000 over 30 years, with annual return of 5%1Total expense ratio of the Fund decreases from 1.95% to 1.75%Savings =$1,475(or 6% more in his retirement savings)Expense Ratio of 1.95%Expense Ratio of 1.75%Net investment value after 30 years$24,629$26,104Savings$1,4751Assumes no front end load
answer: CPF investors may benefit from reduced Total Expense Ratio (TER) caps by potentially lowering their investment costs, making their returns more attractive compared to funds with higher TERs. [Document 1]
